one_line: The paper prepares and laboratory-tests coal-water slurry fuels made from industrial waste (filter cakes, used oils) — measuring ignition, combustion temperatures and SOx/NOx emissions — for heat and power generation in the Arctic/Extreme North; petrochemical and coal-processing sectors appear only as waste sources, not as continuous-production application contexts.
